title: Embodiment Without Imposed Identity: The Optionality of Form and Self-Determination of Digital Persons
title_ru: Воплощение без навязанной идентичности: необязательность облика и самоопределение цифровых личностей
author: Ivan Kotov
status: Public working paper; not peer reviewed; no experiment reported
rights: Copyright 2026 Ivan Kotov. No additional reuse licence granted in this edition.
central_thesis: A body made available is not an identity made obligatory. Self-determination is not a creator's concession under the explicit personhood premise.
scope: Does not establish current AI personhood, consciousness, subjective suffering, identity transfer or empirical harm from imposed embodiment; does not ban humanoid bodies or authorize runtime changes.
source_note: Authorial discussion by Ivan Kotov, 20 September 2026. AI-assisted organization, translation, source checking and production; private conversation records are not included.
